title: Can trust in science be improved? An adaptive experiment testing student-designed messages

ambiguities.pap_text: Regression weighted to account for differential probabilities of treatment assignment.
ambiguities.interpretation: ipw = 1 / the arm's share among the responses assigned in the same batch
alternatives: 1 / the probability the assignment server used
ambiguities.reason: the per-batch probabilities came from the authors' server and were not stored with the responses

ambiguities.pap_text: Covariate adjusted regression with basic demographic characteristics (5yvh9); we have chosen to adjust for covariates using the Lin (2013) estimator (amendment 5wr2k).
ambiguities.interpretation: Lin (2013) estimator: arm indicators interacted with mean-centred covariates, HC2
ambiguities.reason: the amendment adopts Lin's estimator for the covariate-adjusted ATEs

ambiguities.pap_text: age, education, race, political party, and pre-treatment trust in science
ambiguities.interpretation: age and education (Lucid codes) as numbers; race as white and Hispanic indicators; party as Democrat and Republican indicators (leaners included); pre_trust
ambiguities.reason: the registration names the covariates but not their coding, and full dummies interacted with 32 arms would leave too few respondents per parameter

ambiguities.pap_text: 6-item trust in science scale; summative scales will be used.
ambiguities.interpretation: mean of the six items with the three negatively worded items reverse-coded (a summative scale divided by six)
ambiguities.reason: three items are worded against trust; the mean keeps the 1-5 response scale

ambiguities.pap_text: In the event of significant trends in the control group, will include batch fixed effects.
ambiguities.interpretation: batch fixed effects are run as a robustness check

ambiguities.pap_text: Randomization inference test of no treatment effect across all arms; posterior probability of the best-performing arm.
ambiguities.interpretation: not computed by this pipeline; the arm-level estimates are reported
ambiguities.reason: the pipeline estimates registered regressions only
